capabilities: Show a collapsed dash rail on the editor edge, one tick per heading
Preview headings and opening section lines on hover
Scroll to headings by clicking or scrubbing the rail
Open a full indented outline panel with keyboard navigation and folding
Toggle gogoga theme focus mode and hover line highlight
extras: The focus mode and hover line highlight commands do nothing under themes other than gogoga; the README also documents virtualization limits where distant headings jump instead of gliding, and offers a WeChat group for Chinese-speaking users.
problem: Obsidian's outline lives in a sidebar panel, with no compact per-pane heading navigator that stays visible at the editor edge without covering content.

relations.evidence: in the style of Codex's document navigator
Companion to the gogoga theme, but it depends on nothing from the theme

summary: Heading rail pinned to the editor edge that expands on hover into an outline with section previews and smooth-scrolls to any heading.
